title: 第58章 你一定要把那废物踩在脚下！
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚全文完结版
content_zh: 唐逸很清楚杜凌菲来到他的身边，不仅仅是为了照顾唐音，大部分原因还是为了高阳公主萧澜。因为他能救公主萧澜。而萧澜，就是贤妃娘娘的宝贝女儿。所以，唐逸直接将培养青霉素菌的事，交给了杜凌菲。等青霉素菌培育出来，他再亲自提炼就是了。同时，唐逸交代杜凌菲，让他找工匠重新修建一栋小房子。从目前来看皇后没有让杜凌菲回去的打算，他可不想一直住在狭小的柴房。昨日颜霜玉倒是过来了一次，哪怕脸都被打肿了，表面文章她还是得做。贤妃娘娘的贴身女官住在西院狭小的院子，于情于理，她都得出面邀请杜凌菲住到东院去。同时，也假惺惺地让唐逸和唐音搬回去。唐逸还没说话，就已经被杜凌菲一口回绝了。甚至，唐逸能看到这美女眼中翻涌的怒火，如果不是因为身份限制，颜霜玉估计要被赏一顿巴掌了。唐逸交代完事，刚从西院出来，就看到颜霜玉带着唐画兄弟俩站在院中。此时，看着穿着飞鱼服挎着绣春刀的他，脸色都难看到了极致。“唐逸，你的狗屎运，还真不是一般的好！”颜霜玉冷冷地盯着唐逸，咬牙切齿，那样子恨不得将唐逸给当场撕碎了。这个以前任由他们拿捏的蠢货，现在仿佛觉醒了一般，短短几日竟然让他们吃尽了苦头。最重要的是，现在有了锦衣卫这重身份，想要对付他就更难了。“运气是不错，一不小心……就成了锦衣卫了。”唐逸弹了弹衣袖，笑道：“当官的感觉还挺不错，你们随意，我上班去了。”走了两步，唐逸回头警告：“对了，别进西院，否则我会生气的。”颜霜玉气得差点跳脚，唐画手也攥成拳，怒火翻涌。“你得意什么？进了锦衣卫，你会死得更快！”唐画向前走了几步，脸色冰冷道：“将你禁足这几年，以唐家嫡子身份在外行走的，是我。”“除了你那几个不入流的狐朋狗友，京都那些豪门贵族的少爷小姐，只认我唐画。”“刚好，锦衣卫中就有好几个和我关系要好的勋贵子弟，放心，你进入锦衣卫，我会让他们和你好好玩的。”唐逸向后退了两步，装得一脸恐惧：“啊？真的，好可怕，我好害怕……”唐画见到他夸张的样子，差点忍不住扑上去和他打一架。以前的唐逸各种羞辱都不敢放一个屁，现在这家伙出口能噎死人。“且让你狂着吧，有你生死两难的时候。”唐画压下心头的怒火，冷笑：“在我眼中，你永远不过是蝼蚁罢了，想翻天，做梦！”“就是，垃圾，就该呆在垃圾堆里。”唐浩也是鼻孔朝天，冷笑。唐逸目光扫了颜霜玉母子三人一眼，笑了。刚刚消停两天，你们又觉得自己行了？“行吧，你们想蹦跶，那就尽情蹦跶吧！”唐逸也懒得管，只要不牵扯到妹妹，你们想怎么玩，我奉陪。“哦，对了，我现在是锦衣卫了。”唐逸抬头，目光盯着唐敬，清澈的目光带着几分锐利，仿佛能看穿人的心思。唐画被他的目光盯得有些发毛。“我现在有权了。”“我可以查一下你那首名动京都的《劝谏诗》是怎么来的，同时，我也可以查一下……你这金榜会元，是怎么来的。”一听唐逸这话，颜霜玉当场爆炸了。“唐逸，你胡说八道什么？”“比不过画儿，你就这样诬陷他？”唐画死死盯着唐逸，双手紧攥成拳，指尖隐隐泛白。唐逸看着两人的反应，心头凉了半截。妈的，看来是猜对了。不单单是殿试盗诗这么简单，重要的是，唐画的会元，可能真是舞弊出来的。那可是科举舞弊，妥妥的欺君之罪啊！等真相查清那一天，搞不好连他都要被连累。不行，不行……这样的唐家老子替前身拿回来干嘛？都烂到根了！还是想办法赶紧撇清关系，跑路吧！“哦，开个玩笑，别那么紧张。”唐逸冷笑一声，压着绣春刀转身离开。然而他的笑容，却让唐画和颜霜玉脊背发凉。这家伙太危险了，绝不能再留了。“娘，大哥，钱庄那边催债了。”唐浩现在没时间管唐逸，他已经自身难保。为了给唐画办一个风光的庆功宴，他们和地下钱庄借了一万两，期限三日还……现在已经逾期了。“都怪唐逸这贱种，贱种，贱种……”“他怎么不死？他该死，该死！”颜霜玉脸色铁青，跺着脚咒骂。要不是唐逸破坏了唐画的庆功宴，他们礼物收到手软，别说一万两，就算十万两还不是信手拈来？三元及第，京都传奇，谁不想巴结巴结沾沾喜气？结果，唐逸大闹一场把庆功宴搅黄了，那些前来祝贺的达官贵人和世家豪族，走的时候顺带连礼物也带走了。一场原本该享誉京都的庆功宴，最终成了大笑话！唐画也暗恨不已。“和钱庄那边商量下，再拖三天吧。”他说道。颜霜玉和唐浩看了过来。唐画负着手，道：“三日后，就是沈园诗会了。”“沈园诗会这次是大办，是以太傅的名义发的帖。”“听说，各国使馆都会派人参加，甚至连陛下都会亲临。”“只要我在沈园诗会将所有人都踩在脚下，获得陛下赐婚，万两银子算什么？就算是十万两，百万两，也不过是一句话的事。”他丝毫不担心唐逸会揭穿他殿试舞弊的事！毕竟陛下金口玉言，他的话就是圣旨，不可违抗。说他抄袭，那就相当于直接推翻陛下钦点他为状元的事情。而陛下……陛下也不会承认自己有错的。更何况，只要找到且弄死那个小诗仙，这件事就将死无对证！唐画脸色阴狠无比。而颜霜玉和唐浩却顿时激动起来。没错，一旦沈园诗会唐画夺魁，所有困难都将迎刃而解。欠钱庄一万两？到时候估计钱庄还自己倒贴十万两给唐画庆祝呢！“好，我儿有自信就好。”颜霜玉抬手帮唐画捋平儒衫，道：“我儿聪明绝顶，娘当年踩着他娘上位，你现在，也一定要将唐逸那废物踩在脚下，为娘出一口恶气。”……
content_en: Tang Yi knew very well that Du Lingfei came to him not only to take care of Tang Yin, but mostly for Princess Xiao Lan of Gaoyang.Because he can save Princess Xiao Lan.And Xiao Lan is the precious daughter of Concubine Xian.Therefore, Tang Yi directly handed over the cultivation of penicillin bacteria to Du Lingfei.Once the penicillin bacteria are cultivated, he can refine it himself.At the same time, Tang Yi asked Du Lingfei to find craftsmen to rebuild a small house.From the current point of view, the queen has no plans to let Du Lingfei go back. He doesn't want to live in a small woodshed all the time.Yesterday, Yan Shuangyu came over once. Even though her face was swollen, she still had to act superficially.The personal female officer of the Concubine Xian lived in the small courtyard in the west courtyard, so she had to invite Du Lingfei to live in the east courtyard.At the same time, they also pretended to let Tang Yi and Tang Yin move back.Before Tang Yi could speak, he was already rejected by Du Lingfei.Tang Yi could even see the anger surging in the beauty's eyes. If it weren't for her status restrictions, Yan Shuangyu would probably have been slapped.After Tang Yi finished explaining, he just came out of the west courtyard when he saw Yan Shuangyu and Tang Hua brothers standing in the courtyard.At this time, looking at him wearing a Feiyu suit and carrying a Xiuchun knife, his face turned pale."Tang Yi, your shit luck is really not that good!" Yan Shuangyu stared at Tang Yi coldly, gritting her teeth, as if she wanted to tear Tang Yi to pieces on the spot.This idiot who was at their mercy before seemed to have awakened, and he actually caused them a lot of suffering in just a few days.The most important thing is that now that he has the identity of Jin Yiwei, it is even more difficult to deal with him."I'm lucky. I accidentally... became a guard." Tang Yi flicked his sleeves and smiled: "It feels pretty good to be an official. You can do whatever you want. I'm going to work." After taking two steps, Tang Yi turned around and warned: "By the way, don't enter the west courtyard, otherwise I will be angry." Yan Shuangyu almost jumped in anger, and Tang Hua clenched his hands into fists, filled with anger."What are you proud of? If you enter the Jinyi Guards, you will die faster!" Tang Hua took a few steps forward and said with a cold face: "I am the one who has grounded you in the past few years and walked around as the legitimate son of the Tang family." "Except for your few unscrupulous friends, the young masters and ladies of the rich and noble families in Kyoto only recognize me, Tang Hua." "It just so happens.There are several distinguished disciples who are close to me in Jinyiwei.Don't worry, if you enter Jinyiwei, I will let them have fun with you." Tang Yi took two steps back, pretending to be scared: "Huh?It's really scary, I'm so scared..." Seeing his exaggerated appearance, Tang Hua almost couldn't help but rush to fight with him.In the past, Tang Yi didn't dare to fart despite all kinds of humiliation, but now this guy can choke people to death."Let you be crazy. There will be times when you are in a dilemma of life and death." Tang Hua suppressed the anger in his heart and sneered: "In my eyes, you will always be nothing more than an ant, dreaming and dreaming!" "It's just garbage. It should stay in the garbage heap." Tang Hao also sneered with his nostrils turned upward.Tang Yi glanced at Yan Shuangyu, mother and son, and smiled.You just stopped for two days, do you think you can do it again?"Okay, if you want to jump, then go ahead and jump as much as you want!" Tang Yi didn't bother to care. As long as his sister is not involved, I will accompany you however you want."Oh, by the way, I am a Jin Yiwei now." Tang Yi raised his head and stared at Tang Jing, his clear eyes a bit sharp, as if he could see through people's thoughts.Tang Hua was a little frightened by his gaze."I have the power now." "I can find out how your "Poem of Admonition", which is so famous in Kyoto, came from. At the same time, I can also find out... how you came to be a member of the gold list." Upon hearing Tang Yi's words, Yan Shuangyu exploded on the spot."Tang Yi, what nonsense are you talking about?" "You can't compare to Hua'er, so you frame him like this?" Tang Hua stared at Tang Yi, his hands clenched into fists, and his fingertips were faintly white.Tang Yi felt a chill in his heart when he saw the two people's reactions.Damn, it seems I guessed it right.It is not just as simple as stealing poems in the palace examination, but more importantly, the Huiyuan paintings in Tang Dynasty may have been cheated.That is imperial examination fraud, a perfect crime of deceiving the emperor!When the truth comes out, maybe even he will be implicated.No, no... Why would I, the Tang family, take this back for my predecessor?It’s all rotten to the core!It’s better to find a way to end the relationship quickly and run away!"Oh, just kidding, don't be so nervous." Tang Yi sneered, turned and left with Xiuchundao.However, his smile sent shivers down the spines of Tang Hua and Yan Shuangyu.This guy is too dangerous and must not be left here any longer."Mom, brother, the bank is collecting debts." Tang Hao has no time to care about Tang Yi now, he can no longer protect himself.In order to hold a grand celebration banquet for Tang Hua, they borrowed 10,000 taels from an underground bank, with a deadline of three days to pay it back... and now it's overdue."It's all Tang Yi's fault, bastard, bastard..." "Why doesn't he die? He deserves to die, deserves to die!" Yan Shuangyu's face turned livid, and she stamped her feet and cursed.If Tang Yi hadn't ruined Tang Hua's celebration banquet and their gifts had been mercilessly received, let alone ten thousand taels, even one hundred thousand taels wouldn't have been easy to come by?Three Yuan and the third prize, a legend in Kyoto, who doesn't want to be happy and fawning?As a result, Tang Yi made a big fuss and ruined the celebration banquet. The dignitaries and aristocratic families who came to congratulate him took away their gifts when they left.A celebration banquet that was supposed to be famous in Kyoto ended up becoming a big joke!Tang Hua also secretly resented it."Discuss with the bank and delay it for another three days," he said.Yan Shuangyu and Tang Hao looked over.Tang Hua put his hands behind his hands and said: "In three days, the Shen Yuan Poetry Recital will be held." "The Shen Yuan Poetry Recital is a big event this time, and I am posting in the name of Taifu." "I heard that the embassies of various countries will send people to participate, and even His Majesty will come in person." "It's just that.If I want to trample everyone under my feet in Shen Yuan Shihuang and get a marriage from His Majesty, what is ten thousand taels of silver?Even if it is one hundred thousand taels or one million taels, it is just a matter of words." He was not worried at all that Tang Yi would expose his imperial examination fraud!After all, His Majesty speaks eloquently, and his words are imperial edicts and cannot be disobeyed.To say that he plagiarized is equivalent to directly overturning His Majesty's decision to appoint him as the number one scholar.And Your Majesty... Your Majesty will not admit that you are wrong.What's more, as long as the little poetry fairy is found and killed, there will be no proof of this matter!Tang Hua's expression was extremely sinister.But Yan Shuangyu and Tang Hao suddenly became excited.That's right, once the Shen Yuan Poetry Society Tang Painting wins the first prize, all difficulties will be faced.
title_en: Chapter 58 You must trample that trash under your feet!
